The readline pair is a non-ASCII BAREWORD FILEHANDLE inside angle brackets (the `<...>` reader, not the Cast+Word repair #410 fixed); the method pair is a SYMBOLIC REF (`++${"..."}`) whose package name is a non-ASCII BYTE -- the same spelling as t/op/universal.t:112 `++${"23::foo"}`, which is ASCII and drops too.  So the symbolic-ref half is really `++${STRING}` (an increment through a symbolic scalar ref), not a Unicode question, and it is 3 census rows.
